specName: Skills Marketplace — Install Fix + Content Preview + UX
title: rorca-skills-marketplace
_notes: Fix broken skills.sh install (replace npx CLI shelling with direct HTTP fetch from GitHub), add content preview with rendered markdown dropdown on each skill card, and marketplace UX polish (category filters, install-all banner). userStories.title: Fix Install — HTTP Fetch from GitHub Instead of CLI
userStories.description: Rewrite `POST /api/skills/install-from-sh` in `backend/src/routes/skills.ts`. Remove the `execSync('npx skills add ...')` approach which fails with 422 for users who don't have the skills CLI installed. Replace with async HTTP fetch directly from GitHub raw URLs. Fallback chain: 1) fetch `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/{name}/SKILL.md`, 2) fetch `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/skills/main/skills/{name}/SKILL.md`, 3) return 404 if both fail. On success: parse YAML frontmatter for metadata (title, description, author), save the SKILL.md content to both `.rorca/skills/{name}.md` and `.claude/skills/{name}.md` (create directories if needed), register in DB via `SkillRegistry.install()`, return `{ name, description, source, filePath }`. The handler must be `async`. Remove `execSync` import dependency for this route (other routes may still use it — only remove if no other references). Update the @swagger JSDoc to reflect the new behavior (no longer requires npx CLI). Handle network errors with 502 status.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/skills/install-from-sh no longer shells out to npx
Skills are fetched via HTTP from raw.githubusercontent.com with anthropics/skills tried first, then vercel-labs/skills
On successful fetch, SKILL.md is saved to both .rorca/skills/{name}.md and .claude/skills/{name}.md
YAML frontmatter is parsed for metadata (title, description, author)
Skill is registered in the DB via SkillRegistry.install()
Returns 201 with { name, description, source, filePath } on success
Returns 404 if skill not found in either GitHub repo
Returns 502 on network errors with descriptive message
The @swagger JSDoc is updated to reflect HTTP fetch behavior
npx tsc --noEmit passes in backend/

userStories.title: Add GET /api/skills/:name/content Endpoint
userStories.description: Add a new `GET /api/skills/:name/content` route in `backend/src/routes/skills.ts` that returns the full markdown content for a skill. Resolution order: 1) Try `SkillRegistry.getSkill(name)` and if found, read file content from `filePath`, 2) Fallback: `SELECT content FROM installed_skills WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`, 3) Return 404 if not found. Response shape: `{ name, content, description, wordCount, estimatedTokens }` where `wordCount = content.split(/\s+/).length` and `estimatedTokens = Math.ceil(wordCount * 1.3)`. IMPORTANT: This route MUST be declared BEFORE the `DELETE /:name` route to avoid Express treating 'content' as a `:name` param. Add @swagger JSDoc annotation.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/skills/:name/content returns full markdown content for installed skills
Response includes name, content, description, wordCount, and estimatedTokens fields
Route is declared BEFORE DELETE /:name to avoid Express param collision
Returns 404 with error message if skill not found
Has @swagger JSDoc annotation

userStories.title: Extract renderMarkdown to Shared Utility
userStories.description: Create `src/lib/renderMarkdown.ts` as a shared utility. Move the `renderMarkdown()` function and its `escapeHtml()` helper from `src/components/SkillsManager.tsx` (approximately lines 52-83) into this new file. Export both functions. Update `src/components/SkillsManager.tsx` to import `renderMarkdown` from `../lib/renderMarkdown` instead of defining it inline. The renderMarkdown function converts markdown text to HTML with support for headings (h1-h4), code blocks (triple backtick with language), inline code, bold, italic, links, unordered lists, blockquotes, horizontal rules, and paragraphs. Move the skill-preview CSS styles (`.md-h1`, `.md-h2`, `.md-h3`, `.md-h4`, `.md-code-block`, `.md-code-header`, `.md-inline-code`, `.md-bold`, `.md-italic`, `.md-link`, `.md-list`, `.md-blockquote`, `.md-hr`, `.md-paragraph`) from SkillsManager.tsx inline styles to `src/styles/index.css`. These classes use dark theme colors (zinc-800 backgrounds, emerald/blue accents).

userStories.title: Add Expandable Markdown Preview to Skill Cards
userStories.description: Modify the `SkillRegistryCard` component in `src/panels/TemplateMarketplacePanel.tsx` to add an expandable content preview. Add a `ChevronRight` toggle icon on the left side of each card (follows the existing `DetailSection` expand/collapse pattern used elsewhere in the codebase). When expanded: fetch `GET /api/skills/{name}/content` from the backend, render the response content via `renderMarkdown()` (imported from `src/lib/renderMarkdown.ts`) inside a container with classes `prose prose-invert prose-sm`. Display the word count and estimated token count (from the API response) in a small muted text line above the preview. Apply `max-h-64 overflow-y-auto` to the preview container for scrolling on long skills. Cache the fetched content in component state so subsequent toggles don't re-fetch (lazy load on first expand only). For uninstalled search result cards: show a disabled preview area with text 'Install to preview content' and an install button instead of fetching content. Show a loading spinner (the existing LoaderCircle icon with animate-spin) while fetching. Handle fetch errors with inline error text.

userStories.title: Add Category Filter Chips
userStories.description: Add a horizontal chip bar to the Skills tab in `src/panels/TemplateMarketplacePanel.tsx`, positioned between the search bar and the results list. Categories: All | Frontend | Backend | Testing | DevOps | Security | Database. The 'All' chip is selected by default. Selecting a category performs client-side keyword filtering against skill name + description. Filter keywords per category: Frontend = ['react', 'vue', 'angular', 'svelte', 'css', 'tailwind', 'frontend', 'ui', 'component', 'next', 'nuxt', 'astro'], Backend = ['node', 'express', 'api', 'server', 'backend', 'rest', 'graphql', 'fastify', 'nest', 'hono'], Testing = ['test', 'jest', 'vitest', 'playwright', 'cypress', 'testing', 'coverage', 'e2e', 'unit', 'qa'], DevOps = ['docker', 'ci', 'cd', 'deploy', 'kubernetes', 'terraform', 'aws', 'gcp', 'azure', 'devops', 'pipeline', 'github-actions'], Security = ['security', 'auth', 'oauth', 'jwt', 'encryption', 'vulnerability', 'cors', 'csrf', 'xss', 'sanitize'], Database = ['database', 'sql', 'postgres', 'mysql', 'sqlite', 'prisma', 'drizzle', 'redis', 'mongo', 'migration', 'schema']. Style chips as pill buttons with `overflow-x-auto` on the container. Active chip uses the accent color, inactive chips use muted/surface styling. Category filtering applies to both installed skills and search results. Category filter combines with the search query (AND logic).

userStories.title: Add Install All Recommended Banner
userStories.description: Add an 'Install All Recommended' banner to the Skills tab in `src/panels/TemplateMarketplacePanel.tsx`. The banner appears when the search query is empty AND there are uninstalled suggested skills (from the echolocation/suggestions API). Banner text: '{N} skills recommended for your stack' followed by detected technology names as small badges. Include an 'Install All' button that sequentially installs each uninstalled suggested skill by calling `POST /api/skills/install-from-sh` for each one. Show progress during installation (e.g., 'Installing 2 of 5...'). The banner disappears once all suggested skills are installed. Style: subtle surface background with border, accent-colored install button. Place the banner above the 'Suggested for your stack' section. Handle individual install failures gracefully — continue with remaining skills and show a toast for any that failed. After all installs complete, refresh the installed skills list.
